text:
Aisha Patel: Heads-up: MapleHealth requested a 90-min hands-on deep-dive for their infra + app teams next Tue or Wed. They want to cover Dedicated migration, KV cache tips, and cost tradeoffs. Looking for time options across APAC/US/EU.

Tom Rivera: SGTM — do we have preferred slots? They're 20 ppl total but only 5 will be doing the sandbox.

Jules Nguyen: I'm +1 on Tue/Wed. My calendar free windows (PDT): Tue 09:00-11:00, Wed 13:00-15:00.

Marco Li: I can do either, prefer earlier in the US day. Also can run the mini lab on quantization.

Aisha Patel: Proposed options (convert to local times when replying):
```
Option A: Tue 16:00 UTC (Tue 09:00 PDT / Tue 01:00 SGT next day)
Option B: Wed 13:00 UTC (Wed 06:00 PDT / Wed 21:00 SGT)
Option C: Wed 19:00 UTC (Wed 12:00 PDT / Thu 03:00 SGT)
```
Short agenda draft (90m):
```
- 0-10m: intro + success criteria (CS + Maple)
- 10-30m: architecture review + migration checklist (Redwood dedicated -> private variants)
- 30-60m: hands-on lab (sandbox: deploy model variant + KV cache demo)
- 60-75m: cost/latency tradeoffs + quantization quickwins
- 75-90m: Q&A + action items
```

Tom Rivera: Option B looks best for Docs and me. Can we split the hands-on so APAC folks can re-run exercises later?

Jules Nguyen: Yes — we can provide a prerecorded 15-min walkthrough of the lab commands and a step-by-step notebook. I'll prep it.

Marco Li: For the hands-on lab I suggest we precreate a workspace per team with tokens + example prompts. Saves 20 mins.

Aisha Patel: Good call. Action items so far: 
- Jules: notebook + 15-min walkthrough recording (due Mon EOD)
- Marco: create 5 sandboxes, add test tokens and sample prompts (due Mon EOD)
- Tom: finalize architecture checklist, note migration blockers we've seen (due Mon noon)
- Aisha: confirm final time with Maple and send calendar invite + prep doc (ASAP)

enablement-bot: Reminder set: follow-up 24h before session (auto).

MapleHealth (external): Tue-Wed both fine; prefer Wed evening UTC if possible — aligns with APAC ops.

Aisha Patel: Ok locking Option B (Wed 13:00 UTC). I'll send invite and include timezone guidance and the agenda.

Tom Rivera: I'll upload the migration checklist to the invite and add a short preread.

Jules Nguyen: Notebook link (draft): https://drive.redwood.company/maplehealth-lab-draft — feedback welcome.

Marco Li: Sandbox names I plan to create: maple-lab-1 .. maple-lab-5. Will set tokens to expire in 72h.

Aisha Patel: Quick risk note: renewal signal is neutral — Maple mentioned cost sensitivity. We should emphasize cost SLOs and quick quantization wins in the session.

Tom Rivera: Noted. I'll add a 5-min segment on unit economics and a one-pager with recommended settings per workload.

Jules Nguyen: Also capturing a few key prompts + eval checks to catch regressions post-quantization.

Aisha Patel: Great. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: once you've completed your action items so I can close the prep checklist.

Marco Li: 👍 will do after sandboxes are up.

Tom Rivera: 👍 migrating checklist uploaded.

Jules Nguyen: 👍 notebook + walkthrough uploaded.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — invite sent to MapleHealth + internal prep channel. Leaving meeting notes template in the doc.

enablement-bot: Calendar invite: Wed 13:00 UTC — MapleHealth Enablement Deep Dive — 90m. Participants: MapleHealth, Aisha Patel, Tom Rivera, Jules Nguyen, Marco Li.

MapleHealth (external): Thanks all — excited to get hands-on.

Aisha Patel: End of thread: will post a short post-session survey for feedback and renewal health signals.
